statement: 4. The Adversarial Perturbation Case We now turn to the problem of incorporating arbitrary perturbations of the biclustered matrix. For simplicity we will only consider the static inventory model, but note that the dynamic-inventory methodology from the perturbation-free case can be applied to this case also. Our algorithm O RCA∗ only exploits similarities among items – we leave it as an open problem to adapt our methodology in order to exploit similarities among users.
